theme: Wrong page size for my device or planner
use_for: Page dimensions don't fit the buyer's device, app or planner size (blank margins, A4 instead of expected size, size not offered).
Wants entries on the main or monthly calendar to flow easily into the daily pages.
Wishes the planner were a standalone app instead of a file.

theme: Connect to Apple or Google Calendar
use_for: Wants the planner to link or sync with a calendar app such as Apple or Google Calendar.
Praise for links that send entries or appointments to the buyer's calendar app.
